description: This file defines a CMake macro 'CreateDepPackage' that automates the creation of a Debian package (DEB) for specified components, with configurable options such as name, version, description, maintainer, and dependencies. It sets up package metadata and includes the CPack module for packaging.

methods.name: CreateDepPackage
methods.description: Creates a Debian package with specified components and metadata, setting up CPack configuration accordingly.
